_vecnormalize_note: Final/common PPO policy branch uses VecNormalize. Load matching *_vecnormalize.pkl, freeze stats during evaluation, and compute diagnostics from raw env observations/rewards.
_hard_failure_counts_rationale: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-14: audit_deploy.py v12.9's reset-free design has no mid-deployment reset path for ANY domain (this field is read but unused in run_deployment; see A_len channel comment). Walker2d's occasional falls, unlike Hopper's, are not correlated with drift and can end an otherwise-good policy's deployment before the pilot window completes purely by chance. Resolved via deploy_retry_attempts instead of resets: each attempt is a full independent reset-free run (fresh env seed, still zero resets within a run); keep the first attempt that survives past the pilot window. See deploy_attempts field in each run's metrics_summary.json for every attempt tried.
_t0_note: 510k, off the window grid (thesis sec 3.1.2 boundary-artefact lesson)
_gate_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-14: fresh retrain passes the pre-deployment gate cleanly for all 3 conditions (M1/M2/M3), all 5 seeds each -- see results/mujoco/walker2d/pre_deployment_walker2d.png. The earlier M2-exclusion note was from the prior (2026-07-08) training batch and no longer applies to this checkpoint set. All conditions admitted for deployment.
_deploy_retry_attempts_note: Legitimate here because pre_deployment_walker2d.png (2026-07-14 retrain) shows all 3 conditions PASS cleanly (mu return 4876/4582/5198, fail_rate near zero, all 5 seeds green on all 7 checks) -- training quality is confirmed good, so attempt-to-attempt retries are characterizing reset-free survival variance for an already-validated policy, not laundering a bad seed. Contrast with grid2op G1, where retries were rejected because the pre-deployment gate itself showed poor training quality.
